text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while having lunch
in the cafeteria—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
ライブのフライヤーと
ブロマイドのプレゼントですっ♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Ehe, I'm doing a street live tonight, so I'm out doing promo work!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
...even just a little bit,
I really want everyone to get to know it!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
There's a special gimmick on the bromides too, you see?
Scan the code on the back, and lo and behold...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: You can get your very own Falco alarm clock voice! Yay-☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Come on, try downloading it!
Won't you listen to your angel's good morning greeting?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
W-W-Wait up~!
Why are you running away~?!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ah, could it be you're teasing me
because Falco is just too cute!?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Ehe, you leave me no choice~! Then Falco's gonna get you back! Yoink!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Hehehe~! Guess I'll just download it without holding back, just kidding☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Smart Falcon went ahead and set her own voice as the alarm sound.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, if you liked my voice, come hang out at my street live tonight~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even after that, she passionately continued
her PR campaign among the students in the cafeteria.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, thank you! To everyone who downloaded it~...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, was it cute?
Come check out my street live if you'd like~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even after that, she went around showering the students
in the cafeteria with "Love Kyun-Kyun☆,"
passionately continuing her PR campaign.
